title: Implement both selected Gaussian linear maps as fixed tape programs with every column and complete owner return
body:
## Exact scoped result
Both selected MOVE24472 binary matrices have fixed 27-tape graphs with 19 right and 27 left CNOT gates. Full two-column arrays and independent inverse-address, time and history checks passed. Complete MOVE/caller composition remains open. Credits #3834, #5188 and #6992.

## Verification and limitations
Canonical base e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. Mathematical proof, reproduction commands, independent or separate checks and negative controls are in the package. No new complete kappa: the selected bound remains conditional on all five foundational assumptions. This scoped enabling result is not an unconditional multiplication theorem.

## Credit and further detail
Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance; credit predecessor authors. Full proof and detailed PR description: https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/tree/39b40c465f7636a4bb6d70af28595fe8f70f4f3f/research/literal-selected-linear-maps
